title: Autotune canary + backstop validation harness and rollback criteria
creator: Maya Patel
summary: Build a telemetry-driven canary + backstop validation harness for Optimize autotuner and define explicit rollback criteria to prevent cost or latency regressions during automated config applies.
description: Context: Recent autotune rollouts reduced token cost for many customers but caused latency spikes for specific tail workloads (see ENG-33210 retrospective). This ticket defines a lightweight canary validation harness that runs candidate autotune configs against representative workloads before global apply, plus an automated backstop + rollback validation that validates live telemetry and reverts unsafe changes quickly. The goal is to reduce blast radius while preserving automation benefits.
timeline:
2025-11-05: Incident triggered by an autotune apply that misclassified a long-tail seq distribution.
2025-11-06: Emergency rollback performed; post-incident triage initiated.

root_cause: Autotuner accepted a quantization+batching profile with aggressive batch sizes and cache eviction heuristics that improved average cost but increased 99th percentile latency for sessions with repeated long-context queries. No pre-apply canary against representative tail workloads existed, and live-safety checks were too coarse to detect early latency regression before affecting SLO-bound customers.
mitigations: 1) Immediate: enforce conservative default backstop profile for high-SLO customers; 2) Near-term: implement canary validation against sampled tail workloads in a staging pool; 3) Medium-term: add telemetry-based automated rollback if 99th percentile latency increases by >20% or error rate increases by >1% sustained for 3 minutes.
incident_metrics: affected_customers: 3 enterprise tenants reported SLA breaches
canary_plan:
- Select 5 representative workloads per customer tier (low-latency, long-context, high-throughput, embedding-heavy, mixed).
- Route 5% of autotune candidates to staging pool with identical runtime stack for 30 minutes.
- Compare cost, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate vs baseline.
- If any rollback criteria met, fail the candidate and trigger alert; else mark candidate as canary-approved for gradual rollout.
validation_harness_spec:
- Harness runs in k8s 'autotune-canary' namespace.
- Uses replay driver that can play historical traffic traces with time-accelerated rates.
- Includes synthetic tail traces created from production anonymized logs.
- Exposes metrics to Prod-Optimize dashboard and 'autotune-canary' Grafana panel.
- Provides a test verdict API (pass/fail) consumed by rollout controller.
